# atlantis

Local coding-agent control plane for orchestration, persistent brain context, and playbooks.

## Key documents

- README.md: installation, commands, configuration, Agent Skill, and safety boundaries
- docs/architecture.md: invariants, dependency direction, orchestration, brain, and state
- docs/integrations.md: Claude Code, Codex, Pi, and skill installation
- config.example.toml: adapter, model alias, and profile configuration
- evals/smoke.json: versioned evaluation suite

## Core packages

- internal/orchestration: provider-neutral contracts and validation
- internal/adapter: local CLI subprocess adapters and output normalization
- internal/engine: Advisor, Orchestrator, budget, fallback, and resume
- internal/state: append-only run events and snapshots
- internal/brain: vault indexing, validation, context injection, and plan cleanup
- .agents/skills/atlantis: unified operating mode and CLI workflow
- internal/cli: command-line interface
